description: This Java source file defines the ContentSearchEvents class which handles content search operations within the OFBiz framework. It manages search session options, executes content searches with constraints and sorts, and prepares a result map for display, including pagination details and search metadata.

classes.name: ContentSearchEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing a static method to perform content search operations and generate a result map with pagination and search metadata.

methods.name: getContentSearchResult
methods.description: Performs a content search based on session options and request parameters, handling pagination, constraints, and sorting; returns a map with search results, indices, and metadata.
